Post 1
📈 New 20-day low set intraday, then a recovery. ASX 200 closed +41.70pts, +0.46% to 9,020.10 — still 2.98% off its 52-week high. Gold stocks led the charge back. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🏦 Financials +0.86%, Health Care +0.80%, A-REITs +0.80% did the heavy lifting. Energy dragged hardest at -1.24%, IT slid -0.78%. Risk-on with a defensive tilt. #ASX #energy #banking

Post 3
⛏️ DYL surged +8.44% to AUD 1.670, topping the ASX 200. Uranium names catching a bid as gold lifted the broader resources complex. KCN added +5.42% to AUD 5.450. #ASX #mining #uranium

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 6,231.60/oz keeping miners well-supported. Silver AUD 92.62/oz, Platinum AUD 2,480.62/oz. AUD/USD at 0.7174. Precious metals complex broadly firm. #gold #silver #commodities #ASX

Post 5
Index bounced off a 20-day low at 9,020.10 but remains 2.98% below its 52-week high. Does gold above AUD 6,200/oz hold the floor, or does Energy weakness at -1.24% drag it lower? Your call. #ASX #ausbiz
